question: Shaily starts walking from her home and goes 45 m towards the east. She then takes a right turn and walks 85 m. She then turns left and walks 40 m. She then takes a final left turn and walks 85 m to reach an ATM. How far is the ATM from her home? (All turns are 90 degree tums only)
solution: According to the given information, 1) Shaily starts walking from her home and goes 45 m towards the east. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53327459ae99e7738f369722f5eefb3fed2ff65a91f96bfeda2ad4f2a287f392.png] 2) She then takes a right turn and walks 85 m.
